title: Complete scam and impossible to cancel
body: This app offers a free trial that automatically turns into a paid subscription that is impossible to cancel and instructions lead to a loop, don’t fall for it!!
author: titoboy1234567890

title: A daily lifeline
body: When I installed the app I had no idea it would have such an impact on my daily routines. Inflow makes living with ADHD so much easier. Or at least less challenging.
author: Bo2607

title: Great supprt
body: Had an issue with a payment and got an email back the same day with very quick help. Great supportteam!
author: Gimmu1234

title: Like a little zen/focus moment
body: I never thought I would use an app for this but it got genuine good reviews so I gave it a try. I find the modules helpful. The way it’s structured makes for a nice “zen” break every day. I am also really learning from chatting with Quinn. It’s helping me understand my brain so I’m positive about the app.
author: YasSnow

title: Not for me
body: Set up is too long and inaccurate. Not helping at all
author: BunnyBunderson

title: I want my money back!
body: I tried inflow and it didn’t do anything for me, so I cancelled and deleted it. And now, a few months later, they withdrew 189 subscription fees from my bank!? I am trying to get in contact with them to find out what happened, but haven’t gotten any response so far!
author: Dve yuuyuu

title: An app that works
body: I only try to at least make the 5 day streak. I appreciate the notifications that start every day and reminding me to be more intentional with my time. There is no pressure and you learn along the way what is a more healthy way to approach your challenges
author: xxxkleighxxx

title: A user friendly tool
body: This app helps me manage small tasks and get organized. I really love the Quinn feature which is like an on call therapist. It really helps me when things are tough.
author: Journey1203

title: I want my money back!
body:
I recently downloaded your app, with high hopes, but my experience has been very disappointing. The main issue I encountered was the inability to cancel my subscription easily. 

I have tried to reach your customer support, but after several days I am still waiting for a respons. I am extremely frustrated and would like to request a full refund of € 189,- (!!!!) for the subscription fees charged.
author: Mrsapajshd

title: Transaction through Apple Pay without subscription
body: Never got an e-mail or subscription through iTunes, still charged 44.99 a month
author: Catniek

title: So far so good
body:
The app plays into all of the hyper focus addiction traits of our brains effortlessly. 
It’s almost like a game, but so well tailored, genuinely informative and engaging to the ADHD brain that it keeps my interest. 

I’m curious to see whether it’ll hold my attention for longer and, mostly, for it to keep sparking my interest to actually encourage me to come back to it in order to incite change.

I like the lessons. Short, concise. Written, but with audio if you want and with an array of options to change the speed of the text -brilliant! Immediately made me feel seen.

The reflections don’t only require your own prompts, but give you multiple choice or quizzes -smart, makes it easier for me to commit when I do get asked to write out my own thoughts. 

So yeah, so far, so good
author: Mila Akua

title: Do not sign up for trial
body:
Inflow had a positive impact on me. I was happy with the app and the information it provided.

I was not happy when I got charged 200 dollars on my credit card without any warning. This app does not show up in apple subscription and no alert was given that the trial was ending. 

Be extremely careful when opting in.
author: Viince2
